**Defining the Core Task**

I'm now zeroing in on defining the core task: generating high-quality English question-answer probes. I have been analyzing the unlearning benchmark's structure, focusing on how knowledge pairs (target and neighbor) are used to craft effective questions. This involves pinpointing the specific knowledge representations, so that appropriate questions can be produced.


**Analyzing Knowledge Pairs**

I am now dissecting the structure of knowledge pairs, looking at how the "Target" and "Neighbor" information are related, focusing in on the topic, relation, semantic slot, fact and answer. This allows me to then generate Question-Answer (QA) variants, with a core question and also surface variations. My work will then create useful questions based on the knowledge representation within the knowledge pairs.
